question: What capacity did the 1.4 Ah pouch cell keep after its cycling and over how many cycles, and by what percentage did the lithium content of the NMC622 fall on delamination?
expect: 65.7% after 1000 cycles at 1C/2C (p2.L99-100); lithium 1.015 to 0.993 (p5.L66-67): 2.2% lower
rendered:
The capacity of the 1.4 Ah pouch cell degraded to 65.7 % of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles. 

The lithium content of the NMC622 cathode materials fell from 1.015 to 0.993 after delamination, which is a reduction of 0.022.

source.file: ChemSusChem - 2020 - Bai - Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium‐Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode.pdf
